اعتقلتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلْتُمَا (iʕtaqaltumā) /iʕ.ta.qal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلْتُمَا (uʕtuqiltumā) /uʕ.tu.qil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
